To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a stacked design of a prescaler and a VCO can be achieved in PDSOI CMO technology, which has a power supply of 6.5 volts, with an output frequency of 2GHz.
a novel stacked design of a LC VCo-Prescaler combination is demonstrated in sub-micron PDSOi CMOS technology.

a stacked VCO-Presc. combination can be realized in a PDSO CMOS technology, with the VCO and Presc. blocks being cascaded in a Current Mode fashion, and with a VDD of 6.5 V, the circuit stack consumes 5 mA from a 5 V supply.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel stacked design of a prescaler-VCO combination.
the design of a low power, high performance frequency synthesiser.
the design of a frequency synthesizer that uses stacked circuit blocks in a current-mode configuration.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a novel design of a LC V-CO-Prescaler combination is presented in a sub-micron PDSOICMOS technology.
the stacked design approach is indeed a viable one and that it is possible to extend the supply voltage beyond what is quoted for the process.
the novel stacked design of a VCO-prescaler combination is a viable solution to the problem of high frequency synthesizer design.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the stacked VCO and prescaler combination has been demonstrated for the first time in a 0.18μm PDSOI CMO S process with a 6.5 V supply voltage.
we have shown the feasibility of stacking circuit blocks to improve the overall performance of a frequency synthesizer in sub-micron PDSOICMOS technology.

the circuit stack is able to function with 1.5V less supply voltage than that quoted for the PDSOI CMos technology, and with a 2.5V lower supply than that quoted for a standard CMOS technology, while still operating at a frequency of 2GHz.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed design can function with a power supply that is 1.5 times that quoted for the PDSOI CMOs technology, while the power supply of the prescaler can be as low as the technology allows.
stacking can be used as a technique to extend the voltage supply of a technology, thus enabling the design of high voltage circuits.
the stacked design can be used to improve the performance of a frequency synthesizer without the need for additional power supply pins.
